fields.index.unit: What one unit of the index is.
fields.index.units: How many units the index holds.
fields.index.counts: What the index holds, each as a name and a value.
fields.index.parameters: How the index was built, each as a name and a value.
fields.parts[].kind: chat: a language model; embed: an embedding model; encoder: a model that encodes tag-to-chunk pairs; training: a model fitted here; none: no model.
fields.parts[].model: The model. null for no model, or for a model fitted here.
fields.parts[].items: How many things the part made or handled; item says what they are. null where not counted.
fields.parts[].calls: Language model: calls that answered, however many tries each took. Embedder: requests.
fields.parts[].attempts: Language model: every try, the tries that did not answer included. Embedder: requests. null where the tries were not counted.
fields.parts[].tokens_in: Tokens sent in the tries that answered (language model), or tokens of the embedded texts (embedder).
fields.parts[].cached_tokens_in: The part of tokens_in read from the provider's prompt cache; 0 for an embedder. null where not counted.
fields.parts[].tokens_out: Tokens written. 0 for an embedder or an encoder.
fields.parts[].seconds_summed_per_call: Seconds of the tries, the pauses between tries and any wait for a free slot, added up over the calls. null where not measured.
fields.parts[].seconds_elapsed: Seconds from the start to the end, measured around the calls. null where not measured.
fields.parts[].seconds_command_span: Seconds from the start to the end of the command that ran the part, its backup and check included. null where not measured.

index.kind: BM25 index (bm25s, the Lucene variant of BM25)
index.built: in memory, at the start of the run
